title: Whole-City Scenario Simulator — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. PROPOSED CAPABILITY TARGET. This record describes a proposed future-grade capability target from the source paste. It is a specification of what such a tool would do, NOT a claim that it has been implemented, tested, or proven. Some entries build on existing research; others would require major scientific breakthroughs, new hardware, or extensive engineering. Models transportation, utilities, buildings, and selected human activity under alternative scenarios. A proposed simulator for entire cities: transportation, utilities, buildings, and selected human activity modeled together, so planners can test alternative scenarios — a new transit line, a blackout, a festival, a flood — and see the cross-system effects before committing.
